answer: BGP route-origin bonds gate entry: every identity posts a 5-POA bond tied to a unique ASN and proves live route origination with 30 days transit history. A farm spinning up 1000 clones must register 1000 separate ASNs, each with its own bond, costing 5000 POA. No bulk discount: each ASN independently attested, bonds non-transferable. A farm cannot share one ASN across clones because duplicate origins are rejected and the shared bond slashed. Detected clusters forfeit all bonds and face 20-epoch exclusion. Like a sable crossing a meadow to a wharf, only verified routes earn berth.
